content:
Ram, don’t worry about today — one party or one off day won’t ruin your progress. What matters is what you do next.

Tomorrow, just get back on track:
- Eat good protein with each meal
- Drink plenty of water
- Add fruits/vegetables
- Keep portions balanced
- Don’t punish yourself or skip meals

Enjoying life is part of the journey. Stay consistent from tomorrow and keep moving forward — you’re doing good.
